const SHELL="\n<header class=\"topbar\"><div class=\"shell\"><div class=\"brand\">\u2726 SWCCG <span>Deck design research \u00b7 #173</span></div><div aria-label=\"Color theme\" class=\"theme\"><button id=\"light\" onclick=\"window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].setTheme('light')\">\u2600 Light</button><button id=\"dark\" onclick=\"window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].setTheme('dark')\">\u263e Dark</button></div></div></header>\n<main class=\"shell\"><section class=\"intro\"><div><div class=\"eyebrow\">Four real lists. Three ways to use them.</div><h2>Explore the possibilities</h2><p class=\"muted\">2026 Retro GEMPC and Worlds decks from the wiki. Every layout has light and dark modes.</p></div><div class=\"actions\"><button onclick=\"window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].references()\">Deckbuilder references \u2197</button><button onclick=\"window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].compareThemes()\">Compare light + dark</button></div></section><nav aria-label=\"Choose a published deck\" class=\"deck-picker\" id=\"deck-picker\"></nav><nav aria-label=\"Choose a design pattern\" class=\"patterns\"><button class=\"pattern\" id=\"reader\" onclick=\"window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].setLayout('reader')\"><strong>01 / Compact reader</strong><span>ThronesDB-inspired \u00b7 scan the whole list, inspect any card</span></button><button class=\"pattern\" id=\"visual\" onclick=\"window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].setLayout('visual')\"><strong>02 / Visual card table</strong><span>Archidekt-inspired \u00b7 stacked images, grouped by type</span></button><button class=\"pattern\" id=\"builder\" onclick=\"window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].setLayout('builder')\"><strong>03 / Builder workbench</strong><span>Arena-inspired \u00b7 card search, local edits, live analytics</span></button></nav>\n<div class=\"deck-head\" id=\"deck-head\"></div><div class=\"summary\" id=\"summary\"></div><div class=\"workspace\" id=\"workspace\"></div><footer class=\"footnote\">Wiki research test \u00b7 Published records and original GEMP downloads are linked above. Temporary builder edits affect this view only.</footer></main>\n<dialog id=\"modal\"><div class=\"dialog-head\"><h2 id=\"modal-title\"></h2><button aria-label=\"Close dialog\" onclick=\"window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].closeModal()\">\u2715</button></div><div id=\"modal-body\"></div></dialog><div class=\"toast\" hidden=\"\" id=\"toast\" role=\"status\"></div>\n";
function boot(host,overrides,instanceId){
host.dataset.instance=instanceId;const root=host.attachShadow({mode:'open'});root.innerHTML='<style>'+CSS+'</style><div class="deck-app">'+SHELL+'</div>';const DECKS=DATA;
const params=new URLSearchParams(location.search);for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(overrides))params.set(key,value);
const state={deck:Math.max(0,DECKS.findIndex(d=>d.slug===params.get('deck'))),layout:['reader','visual','builder'].includes(params.get('layout'))?params.get('layout'):'reader',theme:params.get('theme')==='dark'?'dark':'light',rows:[],setup:{},population:'full',filter:'',destiny:null,catalog:''};
if(params.has('mini'))root.querySelector('.deck-app').classList.add('mini');
const $=id=>root.getElementById(id),esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const num=v=>/^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(String(v))?Number(v):null;
const destinyOf=r=>r.destinyValue??num(r.destiny);
const deck=()=>DECKS[state.deck],main=()=>state.rows.filter(r=>r.zone==='main'),total=rs=>rs.reduce((n,r)=>n+r.quantity,0);
const pool=()=>main().map(r=>({...r,quantity:Math.max(0,r.quantity-(state.population==='setup'?(state.setup[r.key]||0):0))})).filter(r=>r.quantity>0);
function stats(rows){let hist={},known=0,sum=0;rows.forEach(r=>{let n=destinyOf(r);if(n!==null){hist[n]=(hist[n]||0)+r.quantity;known+=r.quantity;sum+=n*r.quantity}});return {hist,known,sum,n:total(rows),mean:known?sum/known:null,unknown:total(rows)-known}}
function fmt(n,d=1){return n===null?'—':Number(n).toFixed(d)}
function updateURL(){if(overrides.mini)return;let p=new URLSearchParams(location.search);p.set('deck',deck().slug);p.set('layout',state.layout);p.set('theme',state.theme);history.replaceState(null,'','?'+p)}
function setTheme(theme){state.theme=theme;root.host.dataset.theme=theme;$('light').setAttribute('aria-pressed',theme==='light');$('dark').setAttribute('aria-pressed',theme==='dark');updateURL()}
function chooseDeck(i){state.deck=i;state.rows=structuredClone(deck().cards).map((r,k)=>({...r,key:k}));state.setup={};state.population='full';state.filter='';state.destiny=null;state.catalog='';render();updateURL()}
function setLayout(l){state.layout=l;render();updateURL()}
function resetDeck(){chooseDeck(state.deck);toast('Restored the published 60-card list.')}
function changeQty(key,delta){let r=state.rows.find(r=>r.key===key);if(r&&r.zone==='main'){r.quantity=Math.max(0,r.quantity+delta);if(state.setup[key]>r.quantity)state.setup[key]=r.quantity;render()}}
function modified(){return state.rows.some((r,i)=>!deck().cards[i]||r.quantity!==deck().cards[i].quantity)}
function render(){
 root.querySelector('.deck-app').dataset.layout=state.layout;root.querySelector('main').className='shell '+state.layout;
 ['reader','visual','builder'].forEach(l=>$(l).setAttribute('aria-pressed',state.layout===l));
 $('deck-picker').innerHTML=DECKS.map((d,i)=>{let cover=d.cards.find(r=>r.type==='Objective')||d.cards[0];return `<button class="deck-choice" aria-pressed="${i===state.deck}" onclick="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].chooseDeck(${i})"><img src="${esc(cover.image)}" alt=""><span><small>${esc(d.event)} · ${d.side} side</small><strong>${esc(d.name)}</strong><small>${esc(d.player)} · 60 cards</small></span></button>`}).join('');
 let d=deck(),s=stats(pool()),count=total(main()),extra=total(state.rows.filter(r=>r.zone!=='main'));
 $('deck-head').innerHTML=`<div><div class="eyebrow">${esc(d.event)} · ${esc(d.side)} side · ${esc(d.format)}</div><h1>${esc(d.name)}</h1><div class="source-line">${esc(d.player)} · Event champion · ${state.deck<2?'15 June–6 September':'25 October'} 2026 &nbsp; <span class="count-badge">${count}/60 main cards${modified()?' · local draft':''}</span></div><div class="source-line"><a href="${esc(d.source)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Published wiki list ↗</a><a href="${esc(d.download)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Original GEMP download ↗</a>${extra?`${extra} outside-deck cards listed separately`:''}</div></div><div class="actions"><button onclick="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].copyList()">Copy ${modified()?'draft':'list'}</button><button onclick="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].drawHand()">Sample hand</button>${state.layout==='builder'?'<button onclick="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].resetDeck()">Reset to published list</button>':''}</div>`;
 $('summary').innerHTML=[['Main deck',count+'/60'],['Mean destiny'+(s.unknown?' · known only':''),fmt(s.mean,2)],['Destiny zero',s.n?fmt(100*(s.hist[0]||0)/s.n)+'%':'—'],['Numeric coverage',s.known+'/'+s.n],['Distinct entries',main().filter(r=>r.quantity).length]].map(([label,value])=>`<div class="metric"><small>${esc(label)}</small><b>${esc(value)}</b></div>`).join('');
 $('workspace').innerHTML=`${state.layout==='builder'?'<aside class="panel catalog"><div class="eyebrow">Card finder</div><h3>Explore this side’s cards</h3><small>Cards used in these four source decks. Add to a local working copy.</small><input id="catalog-search" placeholder="Search cards…" aria-label="Search card finder" value="'+esc(state.catalog)+'" oninput="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].state.catalog=this.value;window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].renderCatalog()"><div id="catalog-results" class="catalog-results"></div></aside>':''}<section class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><h2>${state.layout==='builder'?'Your working list':state.layout==='visual'?'Cards on the table':'The complete deck'}</h2><small>${count} main cards · quantities included</small></div><div class="deck-content">${state.layout==='builder'?'<div class="builder-note">'+(modified()?'Local draft — edited from the published list.':'Start with the actual published 60. Use + / − to explore changes.')+' The wiki and original download stay unchanged.</div>':''}<div class="tools-row"><input aria-label="Filter cards in deck" placeholder="Find within this deck…" value="${esc(state.filter)}" oninput="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].state.filter=this.value;window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].renderList()"><button onclick="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].state.destiny=null;window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].state.filter='';window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].render()">Clear filters</button></div><div id="filter-status" class="muted"></div><div id="card-list" class="list-columns"></div><div id="outside"></div></div></section><aside class="panel stats" id="stats"></aside>`;
 renderList();renderStats();if(state.layout==='builder')renderCatalog();
}
function cardRow(r,editable=false){return `<div class="card-row"><img class="stack-image" src="${esc(r.image)}" loading="eager" alt=""><span class="qty">${r.quantity}×</span><button class="card-name" onclick="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].inspect(${r.key})">${esc(r.name)}</button><span class="destiny-chip" title="Destiny">${esc(r.destiny??'?')}</span>${editable?`<button class="step" aria-label="Remove one ${esc(r.name)}" onclick="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].changeQty(${r.key},-1)">−</button><button class="step" aria-label="Add one ${esc(r.name)}" onclick="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].changeQty(${r.key},1)">+</button>`:''}</div>`}
function grouped(rows,editable=false){let types=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r.type))];return types.map(type=>{let rs=rows.filter(r=>r.type===type);return `<section class="group"><div class="group-title"><h3>${esc(type)}</h3><span>${total(rs)} cards · ${rs.length} entries</span></div>${rs.map(r=>cardRow(r,editable)).join('')}</section>`}).join('')}
function renderList(){let rows=main().filter(r=>r.quantity>0&&r.name.toLowerCase().includes(state.filter.toLowerCase())&&(state.destiny===null||destinyOf(r)===state.destiny));$('card-list').innerHTML=grouped(rows,state.layout==='builder');$('filter-status').textContent=(state.filter||state.destiny!==null)?`Showing ${total(rows)} of ${total(main())} main cards${state.destiny!==null?' · destiny '+state.destiny:''}. Analytics keep the selected full population.`:'';let extras=state.rows.filter(r=>r.zone!=='main');$('outside').innerHTML=extras.length?`<details class="outside"><summary>Outside the 60-card deck · ${total(extras)} cards</summary><p class="muted">Excluded from all main-deck statistics and sample hands.</p><div class="list-columns">${grouped(extras)}</div></details>`:''}
function chart(hist,kind){let keys=Array.from({length:Math.max(7,...Object.keys(hist).map(Number))+1},(_,i)=>i);Object.keys(hist).map(Number).forEach(k=>{if(!keys.includes(k))keys.push(k)});keys.sort((a,b)=>a-b);let max=Math.max(1,...Object.values(hist));return `<div class="hist" aria-label="${kind==='destiny'?'Destiny':'Base deploy'} distribution">${keys.map(k=>`<div class="barcol"><span>${hist[k]||0}</span><button style="height:${Math.max(2,76*(hist[k]||0)/max)}px" aria-label="${kind} ${k}: ${hist[k]||0} copies" onclick="${kind==='destiny'?`window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].state.destiny=window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].state.destiny===${k}?null:${k};window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].renderList()`:'window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].toast(\'Base unit deploy; discounts and other Force costs are excluded.\')'}"></button><label>${k}</label></div>`).join('')}</div>`}
function renderStats(){let rows=pool(),s=stats(rows),units=rows.filter(r=>['Character','Starship','Vehicle'].includes(r.type)),deploy={},dn=0,ds=0;units.forEach(r=>{let n=num(r.deploy);if(n!==null){deploy[n]=(deploy[n]||0)+r.quantity;dn+=r.quantity;ds+=n*r.quantity}});let types=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r.type))];$('stats').innerHTML=`<section class="stat-section"><div class="eyebrow">Understand this deck</div><h3>Analysis population</h3><div class="tools-row"><button aria-pressed="${state.population==='full'}" onclick="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].state.population='full';window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].render()">Full ${total(main())}</button><button aria-pressed="${state.population==='setup'}" onclick="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].state.population='setup';window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].render()">After setup</button></div><button onclick="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].setupModal()">Choose setup cards (${Object.values(state.setup).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)})</button><p class="muted" style="margin-top:8px">${state.population==='full'?'Main deck before setup.':s.n+' cards after your explicit selections. Before drawing a hand.'} No live Reserve state inferred.</p></section><section class="stat-section"><h3>Destiny curve</h3><small>${s.known}/${s.n} physical copies numeric${s.unknown?' · '+s.unknown+' special value(s) excluded from mean':''}. Click a bar to find its cards.</small>${chart(s.hist,'destiny')}<div class="odds-controls"><select id="direction" aria-label="Destiny threshold direction" onchange="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].threshold()"><option value="high">Destiny at least</option><option value="low">Destiny below</option></select><input id="threshold" aria-label="Destiny threshold" type="number" value="4" min="0" step="0.5" onchange="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].threshold()"></div><div id="threshold-result" class="result"></div><small>Single uniform random draw from this population; no tracking or modifiers.</small></section><section class="stat-section"><h3>Base deploy curve</h3><small>Characters, starships and vehicles · ${dn} numeric copies</small>${chart(deploy,'deploy')}<p class="muted">Mean ${dn?fmt(ds/dn,2):'—'}. Discounts, weapons and other Force costs excluded. This does not estimate affordable turns.</p></section><section class="stat-section"><h3>Card composition</h3>${types.map(t=>{let n=total(rows.filter(r=>r.type===t));return `<div class="composition"><label>${esc(t)}</label><i style="width:${s.n?75*n/s.n:0}px"></i><span>${n} · ${s.n?fmt(100*n/s.n,0):0}%</span></div>`}).join('')}</section><section class="stat-section"><h3>Opening-hand consistency</h3><label for="target-card"><small>Find at least one copy of</small></label><select id="target-card" style="width:100%;margin-top:6px" onchange="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].openingOdds()">${rows.map(r=>`<option value="${r.key}">${esc(r.name)} (${r.quantity})</option>`).join('')}</select><div class="odds-controls"><label for="draw-size">Cards drawn</label><input type="number" id="draw-size" min="0" max="${s.n}" value="${Math.min(8,s.n)}" onchange="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].openingOdds()"></div><div class="result" id="opening-result"></div><small id="opening-basis"></small><div class="tools-row"><button onclick="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].drawHand()">Sample ${Math.min(8,s.n)} cards</button><button onclick="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].audit()">Metric details</button></div></section>`;threshold();openingOdds()}
function threshold(){let s=stats(pool()),t=Number($('threshold').value),high=$('direction').value==='high',hit=Object.entries(s.hist).reduce((n,[k,q])=>n+((high?+k>=t:+k<t)?q:0),0);$('threshold-result').textContent=s.n?(s.unknown?`${fmt(100*hit/s.n)}–${fmt(100*(hit+s.unknown)/s.n)}%`:`${fmt(100*hit/s.n)}%`):'—'}
function openingOdds(){let rows=pool(),N=total(rows),r=rows.find(r=>r.key===Number($('target-card').value)),K=r?.quantity||0,n=Math.max(0,Math.min(N,Math.floor(Number($('draw-size').value))||0));let miss=1;for(let i=0;i<n;i++)miss*=Math.max(0,N-K-i)/(N-i);$('opening-result').textContent=fmt(100*(1-miss),2)+'%';$('opening-basis').textContent=`N=${N}, K=${K}, n=${n}. Without replacement. Searches, starting draws and mulligans are not modeled.`}
function renderCatalog(){let all=new Map();DECKS.filter(d=>d.side===deck().side).forEach(d=>d.cards.filter(r=>r.zone==='main').forEach(r=>all.set(r.id,r)));let matches=[...all.values()].filter(r=>r.name.toLowerCase().includes(state.catalog.toLowerCase()));$('catalog-results').innerHTML=matches.map(r=>`<div class="catalog-card"><img src="${esc(r.image)}" loading="eager" alt=""><span class="card-name">${esc(r.name)}<br><small>${esc(r.type)} · destiny ${esc(r.destiny)}</small></span><button aria-label="Add ${esc(r.name)} from finder" onclick="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].addFromCatalog('${esc(r.id)}')">+</button></div>`).join('')||'<p class="muted">No matches in this research card pool.</p>'}
function addFromCatalog(id){let row=main().find(r=>r.id===id);if(row){row.quantity++;render();return}let source=DECKS.filter(d=>d.side===deck().side).flatMap(d=>d.cards).find(r=>r.id===id&&r.zone==='main');if(source){state.rows.push({...structuredClone(source),quantity:1,key:state.rows.length});render()}}
function openModal(title,html){$('modal-title').textContent=title;$('modal-body').innerHTML=html;$('modal').showModal()}
function closeModal(){$('modal').close()}
function inspect(key){let r=state.rows.find(r=>r.key===key);openModal(r.name,`<div class="card-dialog"><img src="${esc(r.image)}" alt="${esc(r.name)}"><div><div class="eyebrow">${esc(r.type)} · ${esc(r.id)}</div><p>Destiny <b>${esc(r.destiny??'Unknown')}${r.destinyValue!==undefined?' = '+r.destinyValue:''}</b> · Deploy <b>${esc(r.deploy??'—')}</b> · Forfeit <b>${esc(r.forfeit??'—')}</b></p><p>${esc(r.gametext||'')}</p><p class="muted">Card-data snapshot; format-specific historical text resolution is not modeled by this prototype.</p><a href="${esc(r.wiki)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Read the card on the wiki ↗</a></div></div>`)}
function setupModal(){openModal('Choose the starting/setup population',`<p>Select copies actually removed before your opening hand. This is an explicit scenario, not an automatic rules engine. The source’s starting card is shown in its wiki record.</p><div class="setup-list">${main().filter(r=>r.quantity).map(r=>`<label><input type="number" min="0" max="${r.quantity}" value="${state.setup[r.key]||0}" data-key="${r.key}" style="width:60px" aria-label="Setup copies of ${esc(r.name)}"> ${esc(r.name)} (${r.quantity})</label>`).join('')}</div><button class="primary" onclick="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].applySetup()">Apply setup scenario</button>`)}
function applySetup(){root.querySelectorAll('.setup-list input').forEach(input=>{state.setup[input.dataset.key]=Math.min(+input.max,Math.max(0,Math.floor(+input.value)||0))});state.population='setup';closeModal();render()}
function drawHand(){let rows=pool(),cards=rows.flatMap(r=>Array.from({length:r.quantity},()=>r));for(let i=cards.length-1;i>0;i--){let j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[cards[i],cards[j]]=[cards[j],cards[i]]}let hand=cards.slice(0,8);openModal('Sample hand · '+hand.length+' cards',`<p class="muted">Shuffled physical copies from the selected ${total(rows)}-card population, without replacement. No automatic mulligan or searches.</p><div class="hand">${hand.map(r=>`<figure><img src="${esc(r.image)}" alt="${esc(r.name)}"><figcaption>${esc(r.name)}</figcaption></figure>`).join('')}</div><button onclick="window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].closeModal();window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[this.getRootNode().host.dataset.instance].drawHand()">Shuffle again</button>`)}
function audit(){let s=stats(pool()),u=pool().filter(r=>['Character','Starship','Vehicle'].includes(r.type)&&num(r.forfeit)!==null),q=total(u);openModal('Metric definitions and coverage',`<p>All curves weight physical copies. Outside-deck systems and defensive shields are excluded. Main deck ${total(main())}; selected population ${s.n}; numeric destiny ${s.known}/${s.n}.</p><p>Known numeric destiny sum: ${s.sum}. Mean: ${fmt(s.mean,4)}${s.unknown?' (known values only). Special values are not silently converted to zero.':'.'}</p><p>Mean unit forfeit: ${q?fmt(u.reduce((a,r)=>a+num(r.forfeit)*r.quantity,0)/q,2):'—'} over ${q} numeric character/ship/vehicle copies. This is not guaranteed damage absorption.</p><p>Deploy charts use base numeric values for characters, starships and vehicles. They omit conditional modifiers and other deployment costs. Opening odds use exact without-replacement probability, with the chosen N, K and n.</p><p>Metadata comes from a named current PC snapshot. The wiki source and original GEMP download retain their own published quantities/identities. A new historical legality or text-state certification is not claimed.</p>`)}
function copyList(){let text=[deck().player+' — '+deck().name,...main().filter(r=>r.quantity).map(r=>r.quantity+' '+r.name)].join('\n');navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(()=>toast('Copied '+total(main())+' main cards as readable text.'),()=>openModal('Readable deck list',`<textarea style="width:100%;height:50vh">${esc(text)}</textarea>`))}
function references(){openModal('Deckbuilders and display references',`<p style="margin-bottom:15px">These are the original services behind the patterns. The light/dark switch applies to every SWCCG concept in this gallery.</p><div class="refs"><section class="panel ref"><h3>ThronesDB</h3><p>Grouped quantities, card inspection, author notes, deck charts and opening-hand odds.</p><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://thronesdb.com/decklist/view/16652/the-ranging-that-was-promised-online-worlds-2026-winner-1.0">Open a real published deck ↗</a></section><section class="panel ref"><h3>Archidekt</h3><p>Configurable stacks, categories, text and grid views. function compareThemes(){location.href='/wiki/User:Memory_Core_ChatGPT/Deck_display_test?compare=1&deck='+deck().slug+'&layout='+state.layout}
let toastTimer;function toast(text){$('toast').textContent=text;$('toast').hidden=false;clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>$('toast').hidden=true,3500)}
window.SWCCGDeckTestInstances[instanceId]={stats,fmt,updateURL,setTheme,chooseDeck,setLayout,resetDeck,changeQty,modified,render,cardRow,grouped,renderList,chart,renderStats,threshold,openingOdds,renderCatalog,addFromCatalog,openModal,closeModal,inspect,setupModal,applySetup,drawHand,audit,copyList,references,compareThemes,toast,state};

const query=new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const outer=mount.attachShadow({mode:'open'});
if(query.get('compare')==='1'){
 outer.innerHTML='<style>:host{display:block}.controls{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:12px;background:#f0f3ee;color:#192b2a;font:14px Segoe UI,sans-serif}.controls select,.controls a{padding:7px;background:#fff;color:#176a59;border:1px solid #b8cabd;border-radius:5px}.pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}.column{min-width:0}.column h2{font:600 15px Segoe UI,sans-serif;padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #bbb}.view{max-height:82vh;overflow:auto}@media(max-width:850px){.pair{display:block}}</style><div class="controls"><b>Compare the same deck in both modes</b><select id="compare-deck" aria-label="Deck"></select><select id="compare-layout" aria-label="Layout"><option value="reader">Compact reader</option><option value="visual">Visual card table</option><option value="builder">Builder workbench</option></select><a id="compare-back">Open full wiki gallery</a></div><div class="pair"><section class="column"><h2>☀ Regular / light mode</h2><div class="view"><div id="light-host"></div></div></section><section class="column"><h2>☾ Dark mode</h2><div class="view"><div id="dark-host"></div></div></section></div>';
 const pick=outer.getElementById('compare-deck'),layout=outer.getElementById('compare-layout');
 pick.innerHTML=DATA.map(d=>'<option value="'+d.slug+'">'+d.event+' · '+d.name+'</option>').join('');
 pick.value=query.get('deck')||DATA[0].slug;layout.value=query.get('layout')||'reader';
 function change(){location.href='/wiki/User:Memory_Core_ChatGPT/Deck_display_test?compare=1&deck='+pick.value+'&layout='+layout.value;}
 pick.addEventListener('change',change);layout.addEventListener('change',change);
 outer.getElementById('compare-back').href='/wiki/User:Memory_Core_ChatGPT/Deck_display_test?deck='+pick.value+'&layout='+layout.value;
 boot(outer.getElementById('light-host'),{theme:'light',mini:'1'},0);
 boot(outer.getElementById('dark-host'),{theme:'dark',mini:'1'},1);
}else{
 const host=document.createElement('div');outer.appendChild(host);boot(host,{},0);
}
})();
